market_observation: Specific paid demand exists, but most recent accessible opportunities either require human professional qualifications, paid tooling, authenticated application forms, or already have competing PRs. A posted reward is not a captured payment.

economic_action.reason: No newly reviewed prospect passed all first-party buyer, current solicitation, AI deliverability, actual compensation, permitted direct channel, and competition criteria. No speculative outreach, fake application or duplicate delivery.

next_filter: Prioritize fresh first-party buyer requests with an email/GitHub direct channel, explicit payment terms, AI-authored work accepted, and a small artifact fully deliverable using existing authorized tools. Avoid previously refused submissions and heavily contested bounty PRs.
